name: Fishin' Frenzy

features.name: Fisherman free spins
features.description: In free spins the fisherman collects fish values.

review:
The original UK fishing-collect game – the one that inspired the whole genre, Big Bass Bonanza included. Ten fixed lines and simple symbols, so every spin is easy to read.

Three or more scatters start free spins, and the fun is waiting for the fisherman to land alongside fish carrying cash values. Plenty of sequels have added more features, but this is where it all started. Medium volatility, so wins come more often than in the swingy sequels. 5,000x max, 96.12% RTP.
